title: LearnOps model and speech interface (B5, v1)
description: The data that crosses the shared model and speech interface (PRD B5): the meta record of a language-model call (result.meta, B5.1) and a transcript returned by the speech interface (B5.4). A document is one of the two. result.data is not described here: its shape is the output_schema of the task that was called (B5.1).
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). Required is not the same as non-null: every field PRD B5.1 and B5.4 name is required, and token counts and cost_estimate may hold null to say 'not reported' (PRD B5.1). The guide's decisions on this contract are recorded in docs/decisions/0001-b5-model-interface-v1.md: cost_estimate is in US dollars; unknown values are null, never 0; 'fake' stays a provider value for tests only; transcript times are seconds from the start of the original audio, also when processed in chunks; empty segments, words and segment text are valid; no discriminator field (the two kinds stay apart through oneOf); input_hash, temperature, seed, cost_known and a transcript language are not part of v1 (like any unknown field they are ignored, never required). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: result.data matches the task's output_schema (B5.1); invalid structured output gets one retry and then a clear error, never a partial result (B5.2); provider and model are chosen by MODEL_PROVIDER and MODEL_NAME and keys come from environment variables only (B5.2); the fake provider is refused outside tests (B5.2; enforced by libs/model_interface/config.py); prompts are versioned files in libs/model_interface/prompts/ (B5.3); every call's meta is logged to shared.model_calls with no raw learner content (B5.3); a segment ends at or after its start (B5.4; enforced by libs/model_interface/transcript.py). Not decided by the guide and not enforced: a word ends at or after its start, and segments are in time order.

provider.description: local: the lab endpoint; hosted: one hosted API through the provider's official SDK; fake: a deterministic provider for automated tests that calls no model (PRD B5.2, B5.4). The service refuses fake unless its test-only setting is on, and that setting is refused in the lab and in production, so lab and production records use local or hosted only.

model_name.description: The model that answered, as configured by MODEL_NAME (PRD B5.2).

token_count.description: Number of tokens, or null when the provider does not report usage (PRD B5.1). An unknown count is never written as 0.

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds (the unit is in the PRD field name latency_ms).

seconds.description: Seconds. Segment and word start/end are seconds from the start of the original audio, also when the speech service processed it in chunks (PRD B5.4).

cost.description: Estimated cost of the call in US dollars (USD) (PRD B5.1). A local model with no billed inference cost reports 0.0. Unknown cost, or cost the provider does not report, is null and is never written as 0.

model_result_meta.description: result.meta of one model.run call (PRD B5.1); the record logged to shared.model_calls (B5.3).

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt file used (PRD B5.3). Required, never null or empty: every model.run call uses a versioned prompt. Free-form; the PRD sets no format.

transcript.description: Return value of speech.transcribe(audio_path, language) (PRD B5.4).

segments.description: May be [] (for example, silent audio) (PRD B5.4).

transcript_segment.description: One segment. end is at or after start (PRD B5.4; checked by libs/model_interface, not by this schema). text may be empty and words may be [] (PRD B5.4).
